item.title: Vodafone Germany is killing the open internet – one peering connection at a time
item.description:
📝 Vodafone Germany is about to blow that system up. By the end of 2025, Vodafone will have completely withdrawn from every public internet exchange in Germany, including DE-CIX Frankfurt, the largest internet exchange on the planet. And it's exactly what Vodafone is abandoning.
🔗 Read more: https://coffee.link/vodafone-germany-is-killing-the-open-internet-one-peering-connection-at-a-time/
